{{Top}}
'''Ammonia''' (NH<sub>3</sub>)<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> was a gas which some beings, such as [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] and the [[Breather Gand|breathing]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]], needed to breathe in order to survive. [[Cona/Legends|Cona's]] atmosphere contained high levels of ammonia, which could be crystallized into solid [[dactyl]]. Ammonia-breathing Gand bounty hunter [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] was known for using [[ammonia bomb]]s that were toxic to most oxygen-breathers.

A competition-sized [[swimming pool]] that contained ammonia and [[Mercury/Legends|mercury]] was located on the [[Lido Deck]] of the [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]] [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]], the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].<ref name="RPG" />

Ammonia snowflakes were the primary make up of the highest clouds in [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="GG2-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref>
